methods.summary: Sets the look-around matcher that should be used for the resulting NFA.

methods.name: set_reverse
methods.summary: Sets whether the NFA produced by this builder should be matched in reverse or not. Generally speaking, when enabled, the NFA produced should be matched by moving backwards through a haystack, from a higher memory address to a lower memory…
